description: Ledger of reducer-managed forbidden patch paths whose owner_kind is state_family and whose owner current-state-registry.json does not register. A forbidden path cites its owner as the write authority that replaces the banned patch, so an unregistered owner names a write authority that does not exist yet. Opened 2026-09-18 when the owner guard was repaired: it had walked event_kinds[].cell_writes[].cell_family since the authority-commit clean break renamed both, always returned the empty set, and short-circuited on `and cell_families`, so no owner had ever been checked. Closed the same day by the Space result-write coverage batch, which registered both families: space_parent with its genesis write on ak.space.create and its only later write plus compare-and-set on ak.space.parent, and space_child_scope_policy with its genesis write on ak.space.create and the dedicated non-patch policy write on ak.space.update. owners_without_registered_family only shrinks; a new entry is a defect, not a baseline update.
